title: Bluetooth speaker experiment (14 subjects, 6 classes, 31 EEG ch)
description: A P300-based brain-computer interface dataset for home appliance control, comprising EEG recordings from 14 healthy subjects performing a visual oddball task with 31-channel recordings at 500 Hz sampling rate. The dataset includes 50 training and 30 testing trials per subject. The task involves binary stimulus classification (Target vs. NonTarget) presented in a 6-class home appliance control paradigm, with visual feedback provided for BCI applications in smart home environments.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 31-channel actiCHamp system (Brain Products) at 500 Hz sampling rate with linked mastoid reference. Participants performed a P300 oddball paradigm with visual flash stimuli presented on an LCD display at 750 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. Trial duration was 1.0 second with online visual feedback provided to subjects.
